// Copied next to the generated client by app-with-domain.spec.ts and compiled
// with `tsc --noEmit --strict`. Every line below fails to compile unless the
// composed schema carries the back-relation on the platform model.
import { PrismaClient } from './client';

declare const prisma: PrismaClient;

export async function typedRelations() {
  const user = await prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ include: { workouts: true } });
  const title: string = user.workouts[0].title;
  const photo = await prisma.storageObject.findFirstOrThrow({ include: { workoutPhotos: { select: { id: true } } } });
  const job = await prisma.job.findFirstOrThrow({ include: { workoutExport: true } });
  const workout = await prisma.workout.findFirstOrThrow({ include: { user: true, photo: true } });
  const created = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: user.id },
    data: { workouts: { create: { title: 'run' } } },
  });
  const filtered = await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { workouts: { some: { title: 'run' } } } });
  return [title, photo.workoutPhotos, job.workoutExport?.jobId, workout.user.email, workout.photo?.name, created.id, filtered];
}
